description_full: eToro Group Ltd. engages in the trading business. Its multi-asset platform supports trading and investing in equities, crypto assets, commodities, currencies, and options, which can be traded either as assets or as derivatives related to various underlying asset types. The company also operates eToro Club, a membership program providing a range of services and tools to enhance a user's investment experience; eToro Academy, an education hub to improve users' understanding of financial markets; and eToro Money, a money management solution that enables users to make deposits and withdrawals, as well as to trade local stocks in local currencies. In addition, it provides various investment tools and services, including charting and analysis tools and extended-hours trading. Further, the company offers CopyTrader, Pro Investor, and Smart Portfolios program to follow and replicate the trading activities of other users or portfolios. eToro Group Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Bnei Brak, Israel.

financial_summary: eToro Group Ltd. is a small-cap financial services business with a $1.8B market cap on $13.8B of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 2% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $313M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.48× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 7.8×.

Net dilution runs at 20.7% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 16% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.1× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
